args.query:
CREATE TABLE cleaned_measurements AS 
SELECT * 
FROM measurements 
WHERE cognitive_score BETWEEN 
(SELECT AVG(cognitive_score) - 3 * (SELECT SQRT(SUM((cognitive_score - sub_avg.avg) * (cognitive_score - sub_avg.avg)) / COUNT(cognitive_score)) 
FROM (SELECT AVG(cognitive_score) AS avg FROM measurements) AS sub_avg) ) 
AND 
(SELECT AVG(cognitive_score) + 3 * (SELECT SQRT(SUM((cognitive_score - sub_avg.avg) * (cognitive_score - sub_avg.avg)) / COUNT(cognitive_score)) 
FROM (SELECT AVG(cognitive_score) AS avg FROM measurements) AS sub_avg) ) 
AND 
reaction_ms BETWEEN 
(SELECT AVG(reaction_ms) - 3 * (SELECT SQRT(SUM((reaction_ms - sub_avg2.avg) * (reaction_ms - sub_avg2.avg)) / COUNT(reaction_ms)) 
FROM (SELECT AVG(reaction_ms) AS avg FROM measurements) AS sub_avg2) ) 
AND 
(SELECT AVG(reaction_ms) + 3 * (SELECT SQRT(SUM((reaction_ms - sub_avg2.avg) * (reaction_ms - sub_avg2.avg)) / COUNT(reaction_ms)) 
FROM (SELECT AVG(reaction_ms) AS avg FROM measurements) AS sub_avg2);
